hero.tagline: From a granite ridge in central Victoria, a small-batch oil with something to say.

story.title: Our Leap
story.body:
We left the city for a quiet ridge in central Victoria, traded pavement for granite.

**360 trees. 16 rows.** Abandoned and overgrown when we took it on.

A year of cutting back deadwood before the grove would give anything back — but it did, eventually. **Frantoio, Manzanillo and Carregiolo,** finding their feet again on central Victorian soil.

Leap of Faith is what came of it. A family venture, made by hand, made with care.
story.imageAlt: Frantoio and Manzanillo olive trees among granite at the Vassallo family grove, Cobaw Ridge, Victoria
story.caption: five harvests in.

oil.title: The Oil
oil.notes: Bright and verdant on the nose. A clean, peppery finish that lingers.
oil.notesSub: An honest expression of the place it comes from.
oil.imageAlt: Hand-picked olives on the branch at the Leap of Faith grove

place.title: Cobaw Ridge
place.body:
**Crisp winters. Scorching summers. Granite underfoot.**

Cobaw Ridge has shaped olive groves here for generations. The soil is stubborn, the weather has opinions, and the trees are better for it.

Every bottle carries a little of this country in it.

enquire.body:
